about_the_game:
Journey to the Light:

You will embody a hero pursuing light in a lightless world, challenging foes through card battles. The game combines RPG randomness with three distinct attributes, creating rich tactical possibilities. Confront different enemies with optimal strategies. Grow stronger while uncovering the world's truth

Acquire Powerful New Cards:

Defeat enemies to collect cards and build your ultimate deck. Flexibly combine attributes based on enemy traits and deck characteristics. As you progress, your strategic options will multiply

Unique Storyline:

At first, people believed the light was merely hidden. The deeper the shadows, the heavier the despair. Then came decay and collapse. Without light, the world slowly dies. Where has the light gone? How to reclaim it? The hero lit a torch, kindling final hope, and stepped into the darkness

Online PVP Duels:

After reaching certain milestones in your adventure, engage in online PVP battles. Whose deck will prevail? Let victory decide all!
